title: Wiyot language - Wikipedia
text: Wiyot (also Wishosk) or Soulatluk (lit. 'your jaw') is an Algic language [3] spoken by the Wiyot people of Humboldt Bay, California. [4] The language's last native speaker, Della Prince, died in 1962.

title: Wiyot - Wikipedia
text: The Wiyot and Yurok are the westernmost people to speak an Algic language. Their languages, Wiyot and Yurok, are distantly related to the Algonquian languages. The Wiyot people's traditional homeland ranged from Mad River (potawot) through Humboldt Bay (including the present cities of Eureka and Arcata) to the lower Eel River basin. text: The Wiyot language, known to its speakers as Soulatluk (meaning "your jaw"), is a moribund Algic language historically spoken by the Wiyot people in the coastal region around Humboldt Bay in northwestern California.
